summary: Fixed migration 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact integer feet-to-metre rounding) and 0013 (no concat_ws on SQLite 3.40), switched the label view to metres, and fixed stratum.toml (cp1252 collectors, deferred taxon/specimen seeds, TS/SD basis codes).
